reality_delta: The proposed workflow can still reject a Prism concern without executable proof.
main_concern: Rejection needs bounded same-provider rebuttal evidence instead of a RedCap-only assertion.
top_risks: Prism becomes decorative if concerns can be silently dismissed
Unbounded discussion could create a review loop
minimum_fix: Require accept, reject-with-bounded-rebuttal, or escalate for every concern/block.

anti_loop_signal.reason: A reject path without bounded rebuttal repeats the old proof-as-completion pattern.
